column1: # Super Robot Wars 30 (Bandai Namco), Korean SKU, SDK 11.4.3 (NintendoSDK_NVN, NintendoSDK_movie, nnSdk), NVN + CRIWARE. No iOS profile upstream: made from the
# survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py), then checked on Android (android.tsv). The integrated XCI carries the base game, its 1.2.3 update and 15 DLC; the update's
# Program NCA is the code the console runs, and the port runs it too.
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB − 288 MB of bss (counted as used memory): a 3072 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# The map runs at 60 fps. Entering a battle the game sets present interval 2 (30 fps, as on the Switch) and sets 1 again when it ends. No 60 fps patch is
# attempted: the battle's frame rate and its clock would have to be raised together, and they are not found yet
